proposal.reason: Primary change is in **network**: NET/CollNet selection, plugin lifetime, proxy progress/shutdown, and transport memory/connect handling are moved to per-communicator state. **communicator** is also required because comm init/split/cleanup now own `netName`, enforce parent/child shared-resource backend compatibility, and gate teardown paths. **bootstrap** needs review due to OOB device selection and bootstrap net handle setup switching to the communicator-selected backend. **device-topology** is substantively affected because topology/path building and PXN/EIC behavior now depend on the communicator backend. **graph-search** is additionally needed because graph comparison/selection logic now consumes backend-derived topology state (`useEic`) when choosing channel graphs.
